title: The 6 levels of money in India: which one are you?
description:
Salary on the 1st, almost nothing left by the 25th. Which money level are you on, and what is the one move that gets you to the next?
Rohan climbs six money levels, from paycheck to paycheck to the floor where money earns more than he spends. Every floor has a trap that pushes people back down, priced in rupees with real maths.
Comment your level.
